items.title: Bensouda Vows to End Six-Month and One-Year Advance Rent Payments If Elected
items.summary: By Fatou Sillah Talib Ahmed Bensouda, leader of UNITE Party and presidential candidate of Coalition 2026, has pledged to end the practice of requiring tenants to pay six months or a year’s rent in advance if elected president in the December 5 presidential election. Speaking a...
